The adapter does not load dotenv files, and current DSH releases"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" treat `DSH_*` variables as launch settings; export these values in the DSH process environment."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"To uninstall the profile bundle:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## MCP tools"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness exposes these as `mcp__mediacrawler__<tool>`:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| `check` | Check source paths, CLI dependencies, and browser launch readiness. |
| `collect` | Star"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"t one bounded collection run. |
| `status` | Read lifecycle state, required user attention, and resu"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"lt counts. |
| `runs` | Recover recent durable runs and their IDs after a restart or context loss. |"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"
| `result` | Read status, artifacts, and a bounded redacted sample in one call. |
| `delete_run` | "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"Permanently delete one completed run after `confirm=true`. |
| `cleanup` | Preview or apply age-base"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"d retention while preserving the newest runs. |
| `stop` | Idempotently stop the crawler process tre"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"e. |
| `logs` | Read incremental, redacted run logs. |
| `artifacts` | List typed JSONL artifacts us"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"ing opaque IDs. |
| `preview` | Read a bounded, redacted artifact preview. |
| `export` | Create a c"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"redential-redacted ZIP and return its path and checksum. |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Runtime behavior"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### When this is useful"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Use the Harness web-search providers for quick facts and already-indexed pages. Use this adapter whe"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"n the task needs logged-in platform records, creator feeds, comments or nested replies, or a durable"},{"id":"p34s3","text":" reproducible export. It complements search providers; it is not a replacement for them."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Browser isolation"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`browser_mode=isolated` is the default. It launches Google Chrome with an adapter-owned persistent p"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"rofile under `<state_dir>/browser_profiles`, so later runs can reuse login state without attaching t"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"o the user's normal Chrome session."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"`browser_mode=existing_cdp` is explicit opt-in only. Upstream cleanup can close the reused Chrome co"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ntext, so an agent must not select it without user approval."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"### Runs and artifacts"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- Queries and targets are injected over stdin and do not appear in the child command line.
- Only QR"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"-code login is accepted; the MCP API never accepts cookies, phone numbers, or verification codes.
- "},{"id":"p39s3","text":"Comments are disabled by default and must be explicitly enabled for a run.
- `status.phase=awaiting_"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"user_login` tells the agent to surface a QR-code action and keep polling the same `run_id`.
- Final "},{"id":"p39s5","text":"outcomes distinguish `data_available`, `no_data`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `timed_out`, and `orphaned`"},{"id":"p39s6","text":".
- Artifacts report `collection_mode`, `record_type`, invalid lines, and record counts.
- Raw JSONL"},{"id":"p39s7","text":" may contain platform credentials. Logs, previews, manifests, and ZIP exports redact known credentia"},{"id":"p39s8","text":"l fields and URL parameters.
- Credential redaction is not PII anonymization. Exported posts, profil"},{"id":"p39s9","text":"es, and comments may still contain names, phone numbers, email addresses, locations, or other person"},{"id":"p39s10","text":"al data; exports report `pii_anonymized=false` and `safe_to_share=false`.
- Artifact counts are inde"},{"id":"p39s11","text":"xed incrementally, so unchanged JSONL files are not reparsed on every status poll."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"### Export and retention"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"Credential-redacted ZIP export accepts at most 256 MiB of raw run data by default. Set `DSH_MEDIACRA"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"WLER_MAX_EXPORT_MIB` to an explicit value from 1 through 4096 to change the limit. A cancelled expor"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"t keeps its lock until the worker finishes, and concurrent adapter processes cannot export the same "},{"id":"p41s4","text":"til the worker finishes, and concurrent adapter processes cannot export the same run simultaneously."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview and may make compatibility-breaking changes. Release `v0.3.0"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"is a developer preview and may make compatibility-breaking changes. Release `v0.3.0` is tested with:"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6`.
- Node.js 22.19+ on the 22.x line, and Node.js 24+.
- Python 3.11"},{"id":"p45s2","text":" and 3.13.
- The MediaCrawler command contract at upstream commit `5665a27`."},{"id":"p46s1","text":"Run `check(deep=true)` after changing either DSH or MediaCrawler; it validates the local checkout be"},{"id":"p46s2","text":"fore collection starts."}],"truncated":true}
